description:
The configuration defines two local actions for the site. The first, identified as **node_add**, presents an “Add content” button (title “Add content” with the translation context “node”) that links to the route `node.add`. It supplies the route parameter `node_type` set to “article”, carries a weight of 0, and is displayed on the “system.admin_content” and “node.overview” pages. The button is styled with the CSS classes “button” and “button--primary” via its options attribute. Its implementation class is `Drupal\node\Plugin\Action\AddNode`, derived by `Drupal\node\Plugin\Derivative\NodeAddDeriver`, and it is cached under the tags “node_list” and “user.permissions”.

The second action, **user_logout**, is a simple “Log out” link (title “Log out”) that points to the route `user.logout`. It has a weight of 10 and appears on both the “user.page” and “system.admin” routes. The action uses the class `Drupal\user\Plugin\Action\Logout` and does not declare any additional cache tags.
